note: No GPU cloud publishes a clean unauthenticated price JSON, so these rows are curated from published on-demand rate cards and each carries the URL a human can check. On-demand only: spot and marketplace bids are a different product with a different risk, and mixing them would make the aggregate a blend of two markets. Verify the quoted figures when re-fetching — a curated row goes stale silently in a way an HTTP row does not.

rule.min_priced_note: How many rows must actually carry a price. A ratchet, like the anchor's own `ceiling`: the basket has thinned before, ACR-INF going from 6 to 5 priced of 10 requested with no signal anywhere, and `par.Basket.usable` sends a stranger's bill to the FLEET scale once a basket stops being usable — a scale anchors/GAP.md puts 20x to 1250x off market. Lower it deliberately in a commit, or fix the fetch.
rule.note: Median across providers for a comparable accelerator tier.
